# Test photos

Negative controls for grid detection: real photographs, which have no pixel grid. Taken from scikit-image's sample
data and downscaled to 384 × 256 (JPEG, quality 92):

- `photo_astronaut.jpg` — Eileen Collins, NASA. Public domain.
- `photo_coffee.jpg` — a cup of coffee, by Rachel Michetti. CC0 (as listed by scikit-image).
- `photo_chelsea.jpg` — Chelsea the cat, by Stéfan van der Walt. CC0 (as listed by scikit-image).

pixel-snap 0.5.0 invented a 56–96 px "grid" on every one of them.
